name: Default
shortDescription: llama-server running GGUF language models on CPU, with the built-in chat web UI and an OpenAI compatible API protected by an API key.

alerts.message: The API is protected by the generated LLAMA_API_KEY. Copy it from the environment and enter it when the web UI asks for it; API clients send it as a Bearer token.

On first start the server downloads the model set in LLAMA_ARG_HF_REPO from Hugging Face (Gemma 3 1B, about 800 MB, by default) before it becomes healthy. Change it to any GGUF repository; larger models need more RAM.
